# Diabetes Management Plan (SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT - NOT REAL PATIENT DATA)

## Purpose

This document summarises the diabetes management plan discussed during the
consultation. It is intended as a reference for the patient and the care team.

## Key instructions

- Monitor blood glucose twice daily: fasting in the morning and two hours after
  dinner.
- Take metformin 500 mg with breakfast and dinner.
- Record readings in the provided diary and bring it to the next appointment.
- Follow the national guidelines for annual foot and eye examinations.
- If fasting readings exceed 10 mmol/L for three consecutive days, contact the
  clinic before making any changes to treatment.

## Follow-up

A follow-up appointment is scheduled for 15 October. Please bring a list of
current medications and the glucose diary to that visit. Blood test results
will be reviewed during the follow-up. If you experience symptoms such as
severe hypoglycaemia, seek medical attention immediately.

## Warnings

This document is a synthetic sample used for software development and testing.
It is not medical advice and must not be used to make treatment decisions.
